home.text: id="PAGES_CONTAINER" class="PAGES_CONTAINER" tabindex="-1" data-main-content="true"> CALL US TODAY, WE'LL BE THERE TOMORROW! Reliable carpet and air duct cleaning professionals serving Utah and Salt Lake county. Get a Quote Call Now! 801-645-3501 Why Choose Us? All technicians background checked 100% Satisfaction Guaranteed Available Evenings & Weekends Our Services Residential Carpet Cleaning Our four-step guaranteed cleaning process is quick and effective. We don't use soaps, chemicals, or harsh detergents and there is no over-soaking. Our organic formula is safe for kids, pets, and anyone with breathing problems. Residential Carpet Cleaning Commercial Carpet/Tile Cleaning Commercial Carpet/ Tile Cleaning We pre-treat all the carpet which gets rid of spots, stains, and heavily soiled areas. Then we use a non-residue, organic enzyme with a little bit of hot water, that cleans all the way down to the backing of the carpet. Commercial Carpet/ Tile Cleaning Air Duct Cleaning & Sanitizing Air Duct Cleaning & Sanitizing We provide free estimates for commercial air duct cleaning. Residential air duct cleaning is $10.00 per vent and $10.00 per cold air return. Air Duct Cleaning & Sanitizing Upholstery Cleaning For upholstery cleaning we vacuum and pre-treat the entire piece. Then we hand clean every inch of the furniture. Our non-residue cleaning process dries within 90 minutes. Pet Odor Removal We deodorize, sterilize, and disinfect to eliminate and prevent mold, mildew and viruses like Parvo. Area Rugs/Oriental Rug Cleaning We provide free estimates for oriental and area rugs. No need to pre-vacuum or pre-clean! Area Rugs/Oriental Rug Cleaning Click here to see more! Amazing Carpet Cleaning We use the #1 recommended method of cleaning by carpet manufacturers and taught by the IICRC. Our non-residue organic carpet cleaning process provides a thorough deep cleaning and your carpet will be dry within 1-3 hours. Our 4 step deep cleaning process insures your carpet is not just clean but completely restored to it's natural beauty. Most importantly, our cleaning products are safe for children, pets and anyone with allergies or breathing problems. At Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning we set exact appointment times because we know your time is valuable. Next day and even same day appointments are available most days. All workmanship is guaranteed up to 15 days to meet and exceed your expectations. BEST WEBSITE DEALS! about_us.text: id="PAGES_CONTAINER" class="PAGES_CONTAINER" tabindex="-1" data-main-content="true"> About Us With many years in the carpet and upholstery cleaning industry Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning has become the reliable standard for the people of Utah looking for quality carpet cleaning at a cost effective price. We started out as a relatively small operation committed to the restoration of antique Persian and oriental rugs. It is through our impeccable commitment to customer service and our love of the industry that has allowed us to grow into the reputable multifaceted carpet cleaners we are today. As a family company, we understand that your home is one of the most important investments you will ever make. Your home is your sanctuary and no one likes living with musty dirty upholstery or carpets that have lost their appeal. As well to ensure the health of your family it is necessary to make sure that there is no dirt, bacteria or microorganism hidden within the carpets and fabrics of your household. This is equally important to any company or business as the continued health of your employees or clients is a necessity. Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning knows that the people of Utah have a number of carpet cleaners to choose from. That is why we provide free estimates for any job, large or small, and guarantee our work. Furthermore, upon demand we will provide you referrals so you can ask our previous clients how excellent our service is. Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning also provides same day appointments and spot removal, just in case you have an important event and you absolutely must make the best of impressions. Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning: reliable, honest and thorough.

privacy_policy.text: id="PAGES_CONTAINER" class="PAGES_CONTAINER" tabindex="-1" data-main-content="true"> Privacy Policy Consumer Personally Identifiable Information (PII) will not be shared or sold to third parties for the purpose of marketing. I consent to receive SMS messages from Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning to arrange my appointment and respond to my inquiry. I acknowledge that message frequency will vary and that msg & data fees may apply. Reply STOP at any time to opt-out of SMS. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help. Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning understands that your privacy is important to you. We are committed to protecting the privacy of your personally identifiable information as you use this website. This Privacy Policy tells you how we protect and use information that we gather from you. By using this website, you consent to the terms described in the most recent version of this Privacy Policy. You should also read our Terms of Use to understand the general rules about your use of this website, and any additional terms that may apply when you access particular services or materials on certain areas of this website. "We," "our" means Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning and its affiliates. "You," "your," "visitor," or "user" means the individual accessing this site. PERSONAL AND NON-PERSONAL INFORMATION Our Privacy Policy identifies how we treat your personal and non-personal information. ​ WHAT IS NON-PERSONAL INFORMATION AND HOW IS IT COLLECTED AND USED? Non-personal information is information that cannot identify you. If you visit this website to read information, such as about one of our services, we may collect certain non-personal information about you from your computer’s web browser. Because non-personal information cannot identify you or be tied to you in any way, there are no restrictions on the ways that we can use or share non-personal information. ​ WHAT IS PERSONAL INFORMATION AND HOW IS IT COLLECTED? Personal information identifies you as an individual, such as your name, mailing address, email address, telephone number, and fax number. We may collect personal information from you in a variety of ways: When you send us an application or other form When you conduct a transaction with us, our affiliates, or others When we collect information about you in support of a transaction, such as credit card information In some places on this website, you have the opportunity to send us personal information about yourself, elect to receive particular information, purchase access to one of our products or services, or participate in an activity. ARE COOKIES OR OTHER TECHNOLOGIES USED TO COLLECT PERSONAL INFORMATION? Yes, we may use cookies and related technologies, such as web beacons, to collect information on our website. Cookies are uniquely assigned to you and can only be read by a web server in the domain that issued the cookie to you. Cookies help improve your experience by remembering your preferences. Web beacons are small graphic images that allow the party that set them to monitor and collect information about website usage, such as browser type, IP address, and the time a page was viewed. Third-party vendors may also use cookies to track and analyze anonymous usage statistics. You can modify your browser settings to decline cookies; however, this may limit the interactive features of the website. ​ HOW DOES Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning USE PERSONAL INFORMATION? Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning may use personal information to: Provide access to this website, products, or services Respond to your inquiries Bill for products/services Send relevant information about products and services Conduct research and improve programs, products, services, and content Protect rights, property, or safety, and comply with legal requirements Personal information collected online may be combined with information you provide through other sources. Once personal identifiers are removed, de-identified information is treated as non-personal information. DOES Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning SHARE PERSONAL INFORMATION WITH OTHERS? We will not share your personal information collected from this website with unrelated third parties without your permission, except as described in this Privacy Policy. In the ordinary course of business, we may share some personal information with companies hired to perform services or functions on our behalf. These companies are authorized to use your personal information only as necessary to provide these services. We will not sell, exchange, or publish your personal information, except in conjunction with a corporate sale, merger, dissolution, or acquisition. In certain transactions, third-party service vendors may collect information directly from you. Please review their privacy policies before providing information. SMS Campaigns: We will not share your opt-in to an SMS campaign with any third party for purposes unrelated to providing you with the services of that campaign. We may share your personal data, including your SMS opt-in or consent status, with third parties that help us provide our messaging services, including but not limited to platform providers, phone companies, and vendors who assist in delivering text messages. All the above categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties. HOW IS PERSONAL INFORMATION USED FOR COMMUNICATIONS? We may contact you periodically via email, mail, or telephone to provide information about programs, products, services, and content that may interest you. Some features on this website allow you to communicate with us using an online form. Email responses may include your personal information. We cannot guarantee that emails will be secure from unauthorized interception. HOW IS PERSONAL INFORMATION SECURED? We have implemented generally accepted standards of technology and operational security to protect personal information from loss, misuse, alteration, or destruction. Only authorized personnel and third-party vendors have access to your personal information and are required to treat it as confidential. Despite these precautions, we cannot guarantee unauthorized persons will not obtain access to your personal information. LINKS This site may contain links to other websites. Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of such sites. PUBLIC DISCUSSIONS Please note that any information you post in public discussions on this site may become public and could be collected and used by others. Avoid sharing sensitive information in public forums. HOW CAN A USER ACCESS, CHANGE, AND/OR DELETE PERSONAL INFORMATION? You may access, correct, update, or delete your personal information by following instructions on the website or contacting us at [ support@utahbluechipcarpetcleaning.com ]. You may also unsubscribe from mailing lists or any registrations on the site. CHILDREN’S PRIVACY Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning will not intentionally collect personal information from children under the age of 13. If you believe we have collected such information, please contact us immediately. CHANGES Blue Chip Carpet Cleaning reserves the right to modify this statement at any time. Any changes to this Privacy Policy will be listed here, and material changes will be noted on the homepage. For questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at [ support@utahbluechipcarpetcleaning.com ].
